ask: mkae a pol for top 3 dinnr spots
sentence: A ranked-choice poll where each person picks up to three options from a fixed list of restaurants, with points for first, second and third place and a live leaderboard.
use_when: A group needs to choose a place to eat and wants a top 3 ranking instead of one vote
Several people want to show a first, second and third preference
Picking between a small fixed list of options and seeing which leads
Settling on dinner plans for a specific night
dont_use_when: People only need a single-choice yes or no vote
The group needs to add their own options to the list
Splitting a bill or tracking who owes what
Scheduling a time rather than choosing a place
